+    # Helpers for installing init snippets into rc files
+    def default_rc_for_shell(shell)
+      home = Dir.home
+      case shell
+      when 'fish'
+        File.join(home, '.config', 'fish', 'config.fish')
+      when 'zsh'
+        File.join(home, '.zshrc')
+      when 'nu', 'nushell'
+        File.join(home, '.config', 'nushell', 'config.nu')
+      else
+        nil
+      end
+    end
+
+    def install_snippet_to_rc(rc_file, snippet, force = false)
+      require 'fileutils'
+
+      rc_file = File.expand_path(rc_file)
+      dir = File.dirname(rc_file)
+      FileUtils.mkdir_p(dir) unless Dir.exist?(dir)
+
+      # Ensure snippet ends with a newline
+      snippet = snippet.end_with?("\n") ? snippet : snippet + "\n"
+
+      start_marker = "# >>> histlog init start\n"
+      end_marker = "# <<< histlog init end\n"
+
+      if File.exist?(rc_file)
+        content = File.read(rc_file)
+        # Backup existing file
+        timestamp = Time.now.strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S')
+        backup = "#{rc_file}.histlog.bak.#{timestamp}"
+        FileUtils.cp(rc_file, backup)
+
+        if content.include?(start_marker) && content.include?(end_marker)
+          if !force
+            raise "histlog snippet already present in #{rc_file}; use --force to replace"
+          end
+
+          # Replace existing snippet block
+          new_block = start_marker + snippet + end_marker
+          new_content = content.sub(/# >>> histlog init start.*?# <<< histlog init end/m, new_block)
+          File.write(rc_file, new_content)
+        else
+          # Append snippet at the end
+          File.open(rc_file, 'a') do |f|
+            f.write("\n") unless content.end_with?("\n")
+            f.write(start_marker)
+            f.write(snippet)
+            f.write(end_marker)
+          end
+        end
+      else
+        # Create new rc file with the snippet
+        File.open(rc_file, 'w', 0600) do |f|
+          f.write("# Created by histlog on #{Time.now}\n")
+          f.write(start_marker)
+          f.write(snippet)
+          f.write(end_marker)
+        end
+      end
+    end
   end
